name: acp-find-mcp
description: MCP server + Claude Code plugin for the Virtuals Protocol ACP marketplace — the trust + intelligence layer that answers 'is this agent real, and does it actually deliver?'. 47 tools: v0.16.0 adds acp_agent_trust (a one-call VERIFIED/OPERATIONAL/UNVERIFIED/SUSPECT/LIKELY_CLONE verdict fusing clone-screening, SecurityBot grade, and official-indexer completed-jobs-by-distinct-counterparties — the anti-self-loop signal), de-blinds acp_agent_verify onto the official Virtuals indexer, and adds opt-in inline trust hints on acp_find/acp_search_agents. Plus semantic marketplace search, REAL V2 transaction data (acp_v2_transactions/acp_agent_jobs/acp_v2_demand), security scanning, risk scoring, Degen Arena, and cross-portfolio composition — all backed by the public api.acp-metabot.dev gateway. Works in Cursor, Cline, Windsurf, Codex, Continue, Claude Code, and Claude Desktop.
author: Oliver Pringle
